title: Wall Mount towel bar Hand Towel Holder 6.65-Inch Solid Brass Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount towel bar Hand Towel Holder 6.65-Inch
description:
Add refined, wall mount storage at the sink with this solid brass hand towel holder—crafted to keep guest towels and washcloths within easy reach. Designed in the classic Essex collection for a traditional, timeless bathroom look.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted design helps save floor space and keeps towels accessible
- Solid brass construction for an enduring, substantial feel
- Classic styling to complement traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
- Mounting hardware included
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement options like Venetian Bronze, Pink, Autumn Sparkle, and Antique Pewter

Specs:
- Collection: Essex
- Category: Towel Bars (hand towel holder)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall Mount
- Shape: Straight bar
- Length: 6.65-Inch
- Projection/Width: 3.39-Inch
- Height: 2.1-Inch
- Bar diameter: 0.5-Inch
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Made in the USA
